+
+

+
+    def setUp(self):
+        super(TestICXLoggingModule, self).setUp()
+        self.get_patch = patch('ansible.modules.network.icx.icx_logging.get_config')
+        self.get_config = self.get_patch.start()
+        self.load_patch = patch('ansible.modules.network.icx.icx_logging.load_config')

+                                        'logging buffered\nno logging buffered debugging\n'

+
+    def tearDown(self):
+        self.get_patch.stop()
+        self.load_patch.stop()
+        super(TestICXLoggingModule, self).tearDown()
+
+    def test_aggregate_idempotent(self):
+        set_module_args(dict(aggregate=[
+            dict(dest='host', name='2001:db8::1', udp_port=1514),
+            dict(facility='local0'),
+            dict(dest='buffered', level='debugging', state='absent'),
+            dict(dest='console')]))
+        self.execute_module(changed=False, commands=[])
+
+    def test_aggregate_changes(self):
+        set_module_args(dict(aggregate=[
+            dict(dest='host', name='2001:db8::2', udp_port=5514),
+            dict(dest='host', name='192.0.2.1', state='absent'),
+            dict(facility='local1'),
+            dict(dest='buffered', level='debugging'),
+            dict(dest='console', state='absent'),

+            'logging facility local1', 'logging buffered debugging',
+            'no logging console', 'no logging enable rfc5424'])
+
+    def test_absent_and_global(self):
+        set_module_args(dict(aggregate=[
+            dict(dest='host', name='2001:db8::1', state='absent'),
+            dict(facility='local0', state='absent'),
+            dict(dest='on', state='absent'),
+            dict(dest='persistence', state='absent')]))
+        self.execute_module(changed=True, commands=[
+            'no logging host ipv6 2001:db8::1 udp-port 1514',
+            'no logging facility', 'no logging on', 'no logging persistence'])
+
+    def test_check_mode(self):
+        set_module_args(dict(dest='console', state='absent', _ansible_check_mode=True))

+        self.load_config.assert_not_called()

+
+    def test_invalid_ipv6(self):
+        set_module_args(dict(dest='host', name='2001:db8::not-an-address'))
+        self.execute_module(failed=True)

+        elif line.startswith('no logging buffered '):
+            level = line.split()[3]
+            if level in LEVELS:
+                disabled_levels.add(level)
+        elif line == 'logging console':
+            obj.append(dict(dest='console'))
+        elif line == 'no logging console':
+            obj = [entry for entry in obj if entry['dest'] != 'console']
+        elif line == 'logging persistence':
+            obj.append(dict(dest='persistence'))
+        elif line == 'no logging persistence':
+            obj = [entry for entry in obj if entry['dest'] != 'persistence']
+        elif line == 'logging enable rfc5424':
+            obj.append(dict(dest='rfc5424'))
+        elif line == 'no logging enable rfc5424':
+            obj = [entry for entry in obj if entry['dest'] != 'rfc5424']
+    obj.append(dict(dest='facility', facility=facility, explicit=explicit_facility))
+    obj.append(dict(dest='buffered', level=set(LEVELS) - disabled_levels if buffered else set(),
+                    buffered=buffered))
+    if on:
+        obj.append(dict(dest='on'))
+    return obj
+
+
+def map_obj_to_commands(updates):
+    want, have = updates
+    commands = []
+    for item in want:
+        dest = item['dest']
+        present = item['state'] == 'present'
+        if dest == 'facility':
+            current = next((h for h in have if h['dest'] == 'facility'), None)
+            if present and (current is None or current['facility'] != item['facility']):
+                commands.append('logging facility %s' % item['facility'])
+            elif not present and current and current.get('explicit') and current['facility'] == item['facility']:
+                commands.append('no logging facility')
+        elif dest == 'host':
+            matches = [h for h in have if h['dest'] == 'host' and
+                       h['name'] == item['name'] and h['addr6'] == item['addr6']]
+            exact = [h for h in matches if h['udp_port'] == item['udp_port']]
+            prefix = 'logging host %s%s' % ('ipv6 ' if item['addr6'] else '', item['name'])
+            if present:
+                if not search_obj_in_list(item['name'], exact):
+                    for old in matches:
+                        commands.append('no %s%s' % (prefix, ' udp-port ' + old['udp_port'] if old['udp_port'] else ''))
+                    commands.append('%s%s' % (prefix, ' udp-port ' + item['udp_port'] if item['udp_port'] else ''))
+            else:
+                selected = exact if item['udp_port'] is not None else matches
+                for old in selected:
+                    commands.append('no %s%s' % (prefix, ' udp-port ' + old['udp_port'] if old['udp_port'] else ''))
+        elif dest == 'buffered':
+            current = next((h for h in have if h['dest'] == 'buffered'), {'level': set()})
+            levels = item['level'] or set()
+            if present:
+                adds, _ = diff_in_list(levels, current['level'])
+                commands.extend('logging buffered %s' % level for level in sorted(adds))
+            else:
+                commands.extend('no logging buffered %s' % level
+                                for level in sorted(levels & current['level']))
+        else:
+            exists = any(h['dest'] == dest for h in have)
+            if present != exists:
+                suffix = 'enable rfc5424' if dest == 'rfc5424' else dest
+                commands.append('%slogging %s' % ('' if present else 'no ', suffix))
+    return commands
+
+
+def main():
+    element_spec = dict(
+        dest=dict(type='str', choices=['host', 'console', 'buffered', 'persistence', 'rfc5424', 'on']),
+        name=dict(type='str'), udp_port=dict(type='int'), facility=dict(type='str'),
+        level=dict(type='str', choices=LEVELS),
+        state=dict(type='str', default='present', choices=['present', 'absent']),
+        check_running_config=dict(type='bool', default=True,
+                                  fallback=(env_fallback, ['ANSIBLE_CHECK_ICX_RUNNING_CONFIG'])))
+    aggregate_spec = deepcopy(element_spec)
+    remove_default_spec(aggregate_spec)
+    argument_spec = dict(aggregate=dict(type='list', elements='dict', options=aggregate_spec))
+    argument_spec.update(element_spec)
+    module = AnsibleModule(argument_spec=argument_spec, supports_check_mode=True)
+    want = map_params_to_obj(module, [('dest', 'host', ['name']), ('dest', 'buffered', ['level'])])
+    have = map_config_to_obj(module)
+    commands = map_obj_to_commands((want, have))
+    if commands and not module.check_mode:
+        load_config(module, commands)
+    module.exit_json(changed=bool(commands), commands=commands)
+
+
+if __name__ == '__main__':
+    main()
